main_text.p: Notandum tamen, olei non multum Nota co- acetariis immitti debere, ventriculi enim tra[?] com-osrelaxat, appetentiamque reftinguit magis munem[?] quàm excitat. In ventriculo enim robo-prepara- rando incidentia & aftringentia adhibenda di modi[?] funt non relaxantia, vt funt oleofa & vn-NB. guinofa. Quare improbantur eiufmodi Quæ ace- acetaria, quæ in quibufdam locis paran-taria fint tur ex immodico butyro feruefacto, olei noxia. vicem fupplente ob caufam iam comme-moratam. In vniuerfum quoque damnan-Nocen- tur acetaria, quæ multis in locis præfer-ti[?]ima a- tim circa autumnum fiunt ex caule capita-cetaria to minutum diffecto acetoque perfufo: quæ fiunt (vulgus nominat weissen Salat) cuius ex caule tanta est cupido, vt in lautioribus etiam capitato & fplendidioribus conuiuiis inter primas crudo am- menfarum delitias habeatur, primumque fumnali mereatur locum: eo enim venere mores vtpluri- luxuriaque, vt gulæ potius quam vitæ mum te- habeatur ratio. Abdicanda denique ace-pore. Gu- taria funt, quæ calidis herbis vel aromati-lidosenim bus,vt pipere, faleque non funt contempe-humores rata, quod hodie ab omnibus feré negligi crudosq, animaduerto, etiam nitidiorem & delica-accumu- tiorem vitam fequentibus, qui non raro pe-lant. cudum inftar ea turgidis buccis ingluti-Nota co- unt,quod fæpe ad ftuporem vfque miratus tra ace- fum. tarioph- X 4 Stultè gos.

page.notes: Right-margin notes are partly illegible in the scan and are given as best read; the margin reads "Nota co-", "NB.", "Quæ ace-", "taria fint", "noxia.", "Nocen-", "Nota co-" and italic fragments. Several italic words in the main text (tra, munem, di modi, ti[?]ima, capitato, fumnali, vtpluri-, crudosq, lant.) are not certain and should be checked against the scan. The line of the running head is hard to read. The catchword at the foot reads "Stultè" in the scan and is set as printed; the bottom line "X 4" is a gathering mark, not transcribed. The paragraph is one continuous printed paragraph.
